vets.desc: A select group of certified veterinarians specialized in caring for and treating pets

services.desc: We provide a comprehensive range of remote veterinary services to ensure the health and happiness of your pet.
services.cardVideoDesc: Connect with a specialized veterinarian via a clear and secure video call anytime you need.
services.cardRecordDesc: Keep all your pet's health history, vaccinations, and prescriptions in one safe and accessible place.
services.cardRxDesc: Receive a digital prescription, signed and certified by the vet, immediately after your consultation ends.
services.cardNotifyDesc: A smart system that reminds you of your pet's vaccination schedules and routine medications on time.
services.cardFollowDesc: Free follow-up consultation within 48 hours of any paid consultation to ensure your pet's recovery.
services.cardLoyaltyDesc: Earn points with every consultation and redeem them for discounts and free services for your pampered pet.

how.desc: Get a specialized medical consultation for your pet in just a few minutes
how.step1Desc: Sign up quickly and add your pet's medical profile with all key health details.
how.step2Desc: Browse the vets' list, read reviews, and select the right specialist for your pet's condition.
how.step3Desc: Complete your secure online payment and confirm the consultation appointment at your convenience.
how.step4Desc: Join the video call and get your diagnosis and medical prescription instantly.

testimonials.desc: Real stories and experiences from the growing Raouf community
testimonials.user1Text: "Wonderful experience! My cat, Mremah, had a skin issue. After a 20-minute consultation with Dr. Nouf, we got the diagnosis and treatment. Unmatched service!"
testimonials.user2Text: "Raouf saved my cat, Brutus, late at night! I didn't know what was hurting him. The doctor diagnosed the condition instantly and guided me to the nearest pharmacy. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!"
testimonials.user3Text: "The free follow-up is an amazing feature. I consulted the vet, and two days later he checked back on us for free. It's clear the platform truly cares about our cats' health, not just money."
